title: Patch: one loading state and one empty state, with the tavern's look

**Issue #2108 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #2108: Patch: one loading state and one empty state, with the tavern's look Opened by @MaxGoetzmann. ### What it does Loading and empty screens are bare lines of text ("Loading…", "No decks yet."), each styled by its own screen. They are the most generic-looking parts of the client. Make one shared loading state and one shared empty state with the tavern's look and a little character, and use them across the menus. An empty state offers the obvious next step where there is one. ### Acceptance - The menus' loading and empty states share one look. - A fast load doesn't flash the loading state. - Reduced motion keeps the loading state still. ### Blocked by, part of Blocked by #2106 ## Plan _Written by `claude-3` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40686126427)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ **Goal.** The menus get one loading state and one empty state, both in the tavern's look. - **Loading** is the existing skeleton (`skeleton/Skeleton.tsx`, R2115000), recoloured in brass with a gold sheen. Its blocks and the shell's waiting panel stay hidden until a wait outlasts `SKELETON_DELAY_MS` (300 ms), so **a fast load doesn't flash the loading state**. **Reduced motion keeps it still**, as it already does. - **Empty** is a new `empty/EmptyState.tsx`: a brass tankard beside the words and, where there is an obvious next step, one control for it.
